verdict.rationale: The pack has no moderation endpoint, safety settings, or documented guardrail guidance. The only relevant primitives are implicit. Client-side function calling (the model requests a call, you execute it locally and return the result) gives the developer a natural point to gate actions. Schema-guaranteed structured outputs let you validate output before acting on it. Missing for 10: a moderation or content-classification endpoint, configurable safety settings or filters, documented patterns for gating or approving model output or tool actions, and independent corroboration.
